tasks.label: build main cpp
args: if (!(Test-Path "${workspaceFolder}\build")) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "${workspaceFolder}\build" | Out-Null }; g++ -g -O0 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\main.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.o"; g++ -g -O0 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\database\Database.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\Database.o"; g++ -g -O0 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\ApartmentRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\ApartmentRepository.o"; g++ -g -O0 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\ResidentRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\ResidentRepository.o"; g++ -g -O0 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\BillRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\BillRepository.o"; gcc -g -O0 -std=c99 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\sqlite3.c" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\sqlite3.o"; g++ -g -O0 "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\Database.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\ApartmentRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\ResidentRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\BillRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\sqlite3.o" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.exe"

tasks.label: build main cpp release
args: if (!(Test-Path "${workspaceFolder}\build")) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "${workspaceFolder}\build" | Out-Null }; g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\main.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.o"; g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\database\Database.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\Database.o"; g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\ApartmentRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\ApartmentRepository.o"; g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\ResidentRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\ResidentRepository.o"; g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\repositories\BillRepository.cpp" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\BillRepository.o"; gcc -O2 -std=c99 -I"${workspaceFolder}" -c "${workspaceFolder}\sqlite3.c" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\sqlite3.o"; g++ -O2 "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\Database.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\ApartmentRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\ResidentRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\BillRepository.o" "${workspaceFolder}\build\sqlite3.o" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\main.exe"
